title: Best n8n alternatives, hosted and self-hosted | 50agents
description: n8n alternatives compared: Activepieces to keep self-hosting, Make for a visual canvas, Zapier for 10,541+ apps, Gumloop for AI agents, and 50agents.
tableH2: The best n8n alternatives, side by side
answer: Activepieces is open source and self-hostable like n8n.
Make offers a visual canvas, Zapier connects 10,541+ apps, Gumloop builds AI agents, and 50agents builds the job from plain words.
line: Say the job in plain words; Captain builds it and runs it.

faqs.q: Which open-source tool is closest to n8n?
faqs.a: Activepieces. Its core is MIT-licensed and it self-hosts with Docker Compose or Kubernetes, including air-gapped installs.
n8n has no free cloud plan; its cloud trial includes 1,000 executions. A self-hosted version is available on GitHub.

faqs.q: Is there an n8n alternative for non-developers?
faqs.a: In 50agents you describe the job in plain words and Captain builds it, with no nodes to wire. Make offers a visual canvas instead of code.

faqs.q: Can I import n8n workflows into another tool?
faqs.a: n8n workflows download as JSON for n8n. In another tool you rebuild them, so start with the ones that run most. To choose the tool, read [Zapier vs Make vs n8n for a small team](/guides/zapier-vs-make-vs-n8n-for-a-small-team).
Starter is €20 a month billed yearly for 2.5K executions. Pro is €50 a month billed yearly for 10K.
Make has JavaScript or Python steps, and so does Zapier. 50agents has no code step.

faqs.q: Which alternative has a flat team price?
faqs.a: Activepieces Plus is $20 a month flat for 10,000 credits and up to 5 users.

faqs.q: How many apps do the alternatives list?
faqs.a: Zapier connects 10,541+ apps and Make 3,500+. Activepieces has 770+. 50agents works with 2,300+ apps through viaSocket.

faqs.q: When does an n8n alternative make sense?
faqs.a: When you want a free cloud plan, which n8n does not offer, or more than Starter's 2.5K executions a month, or would rather describe a job than build each workflow by hand. For self-hosting or code steps, stay with n8n.
